=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
# TOPOLOGY: jq

## story architecture
summary:      Define the standalone jq interpreter architecture and module boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
provides:     interpreter architecture, evaluator boundaries, CLI contract
consumes:     sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l
stack:        common.md, python.md
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Author the implementation architecture for a standard-library-only Python jq interpreter.
  Define lexer, parser, AST, generator evaluator, paths, builtins, runtime errors, and CLI
  boundaries. Preserve the supplied jq interface and prohibit third-party implementations,
  system jq delegation, network access, and source-asset modification.

## story foundation-001
summary:      Stage the pinned jq specifications and conformance assets.
type:         foundational
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Foundation-Assets.md
covers:       FOUNDATION-001
provides:     sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l, sources/builtin.jq, sources/run_conformance.py, sources/full_test.sh, sources/exclusions.txt
consumes:     ARCHITECTURE.md
depends:      architecture
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l, sources/builtin.jq, sources/run_conformance.py, sources/full_test.sh, sources/exclusions.txt
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Stage every declared source asset byte-for-byte under sources/. Verify corpus parsing,
  exclusion consistency, and the expected corpus shape by importing the supplied harness
  parser directly. Do not modify or execute the scoring harness for this story.

## story foundation-002
summary:      Implement the executable jq command-line boundary.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Executable-Contract.md
covers:       FOUNDATION-002
provides:     ./jq, -c CLI, JSON stdin stream, compact JSON stdout stream, exit codes 0/3/5
consumes:     ARCHITECTURE.md
depends:      architecture, foundation-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/run_conformance.py
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Deliver an executable named jq accepting the exercised -c program form. Read JSON values
  from stdin, emit each generated value as one compact JSON line, send diagnostics to stderr,
  and distinguish compile exit 3 from runtime exit 5 while preserving partial output.

## story foundation-003
summary:      Document the jq executable interface and verification command.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Project-Documentation.md
covers:       FOUNDATION-003
provides:     README.md
consumes:     ./jq
depends:      foundation-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Write a concise README documenting the -c stdin/stdout interface, exit codes, standard
  library constraint, and the supplied sh sources/full_test.sh verification command.

## story frontend-001
summary:      Implement jq lexical scanning.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Lexer.md
covers:       FRONTEND-001
provides:     lexer, tokens, literals, interpolation, comments
consumes:     ARCHITECTURE.md, sources/lexer.l
depends:      foundation-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/lexer.l, sources/jq.test, sources/jq-manual.txt
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement lexical scanning for identifiers, bindings, literals, strings, interpolation,
  formats, comments, operators, delimiters, and invalid characters according to lexer.l.

## story frontend-002
summary:      Implement jq expression parsing and AST construction.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Parser.md
covers:       FRONTEND-002
provides:     parser, AST, precedence, expressions, constructors
consumes:     lexer, sources/parser.y
depends:      frontend-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l, sources/jq.test, sources/jq-manual.txt
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Build the parser and AST with the precedence, associativity, suffix, collection, object,
  conditional, error, and assignment forms defined by parser.y.

## story frontend-003
summary:      Reject invalid jq programs at compile time.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Compile-Errors.md
covers:       FRONTEND-003
provides:     compile validation, module grammar rejection, undefined-symbol rejection
consumes:     parser, AST
depends:      frontend-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/parser.y, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Add static validation and compile diagnostics. Reject malformed syntax, invalid object keys,
  undefined variables and labels, invalid module metadata, and unsupported module grammar with
  exit code 3.

## story frontend-004
summary:      Implement user-defined functions and lexical scope.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Functions-and-Scope.md
covers:       FRONTEND-004
provides:     def, filter arguments, value arguments, closures, recursion, redefinition
consumes:     parser, AST, generator evaluator
depends:      frontend-002, core-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement lexical function environments, filter and value parameters, closures, recursive
  definitions, arity, forward visibility rules, and scoped redefinition semantics.

## story frontend-005
summary:      Implement destructuring bindings and ?// alternatives.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Destructuring.md
covers:       FRONTEND-005
provides:     array patterns, object patterns, missing bindings, ?// alternatives
consumes:     parser, AST, generator evaluator
depends:      frontend-004
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement array and object pattern matching, null bindings for missing members, alternative
  pattern backtracking, and retry behavior when downstream evaluation raises.

## story core-001
summary:      Implement the stream-based generator evaluator.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Generator-Core.md
covers:       CORE-001
provides:     ordered filter streams, backtracking, multiplicity, empty
consumes:     parser, AST
depends:      frontend-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement filters as ordered generators yielding zero or more values. Preserve comma and
  pipe ordering, cartesian evaluation, downstream execution, backtracking, empty, and partial
  output before runtime errors.

## story core-002
summary:      Implement basic jq filters and constructors.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Core-Filters.md
covers:       CORE-002
provides:     identity, literals, field access, indexing, iteration, slices, arrays, objects, recurse
consumes:     generator evaluator
depends:      core-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement identity, literals, comma and pipe composition, arrays, objects, field access,
  dynamic indexing, iteration, slices, recursive descent, optional access, and empty.

## story core-003
summary:      Implement arithmetic, comparison, and boolean operators.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Operators.md
covers:       CORE-003
provides:     arithmetic operators, comparisons, and, or, not, jq ordering
consumes:     generator evaluator
depends:      core-001, core-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement jq type-directed arithmetic, recursive object merge, string and array operations,
  numeric behavior, structural equality and ordering, cartesian operands, truthiness, and
  boolean operators with their runtime errors.

## story core-004
summary:      Implement jq error handling and control flow.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Control-and-Errors.md
covers:       CORE-004
provides:     if, elif, else, try, catch, ?, //, labels, breaks, runtime errors
consumes:     generator evaluator, operators
depends:      core-001, core-002, core-003
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement conditional streams, try/catch and optional suppression, defined-or defaults,
  lexical labels and breaks, error propagation, and runtime exit behavior.

## story paths-001
summary:      Implement jq path discovery and access.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-Path-Access.md
covers:       PATHS-001
provides:     path, paths, getpath, path expressions
consumes:     generator evaluator, core filters
depends:      core-004
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement exact and pattern path expressions, path and paths discovery, getpath reads,
  missing-value behavior, and invalid path expression errors.

## story paths-002
summary:      Implement immutable path mutation and deletion.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-Path-Mutation.md
covers:       PATHS-002
provides:     setpath, delpaths, del, immutable nested updates and deletion
consumes:     path, getpath, generator evaluator
depends:      paths-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement immutable path creation, replacement, deletion, array growth, slice deletion,
  invalid path handling, and depth protections for setpath and delpaths.

## story paths-003
summary:      Implement jq assignment operators.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-Assignments.md
covers:       PATHS-003
provides:     =, |=, +=, -=, *=, /=, %=, //=
consumes:     path, getpath, setpath, delpaths
depends:      paths-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement plain and update assignment over single and multiple paths, generator RHS
  multiplicity, deletion through empty, arithmetic assignment, and immutable snapshots.

## story control-001
summary:      Implement reductions and bounded iteration.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Reductions.md
covers:       CONTROL-001
provides:     reduce, foreach, limit, skip, first, last, nth
consumes:     generator evaluator, destructuring, assignments
depends:      frontend-005, paths-003
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement accumulator initialization and updates, foreach extraction, generator bounds,
  skipping, first/last/nth behavior, and label-aware early termination.

## story control-002
summary:      Implement recursive generator controls.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Recursive-Control.md
covers:       CONTROL-002
provides:     while, until, repeat, recurse
consumes:     generator evaluator, control flow
depends:      control-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement recursive stream generation for while, until, repeat, recurse, conditional
  recursion, multiplicity, termination, and tail-safe traversal.

## story control-003
summary:      Implement generator predicates and collection utilities.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-Generator-Utilities.md
covers:       CONTROL-003
provides:     any, all, isempty, combinations, range, transpose, in, inside
consumes:     generator evaluator, recursive controls
depends:      control-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement predicate short-circuiting, emptiness checks, ranges, Cartesian combinations,
  jagged transpose, membership helpers, and generator argument evaluation.

## story builtins-001
summary:      Implement structural and collection builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Structural-Builtins.md
covers:       BUILTINS-001
provides:     type, length, keys, containment, entries, map, flatten, sort, grouping, uniqueness, join
consumes:     generator evaluator, operators
depends:      control-003
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement structural selectors and collection functions including type, length, keys,
  contains, has, entries, mapping, flattening, sorting, grouping, uniqueness, joins, and
  related array/object helpers.

## story builtins-002
summary:      Implement string and Unicode builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-String-Builtins.md
covers:       BUILTINS-002
provides:     trim, split, join, explode, implode, indices, substring and ASCII helpers
consumes:     generator evaluator
depends:      builtins-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement Unicode-aware string length and whitespace operations, splitting, joining,
  codepoint conversion, indices, substring helpers, prefix/suffix checks, and ASCII case
  conversion with jq error semantics.

## story builtins-003
summary:      Implement regular-expression builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Regex-Builtins.md
covers:       BUILTINS-003
provides:     test, match, capture, scan, split, splits, sub, gsub
consumes:     generator evaluator, string builtins
depends:      builtins-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement standard-library regex behavior for matching, captures, scans, regex splitting,
  substitutions, global substitutions, flags, offsets, lengths, and replacement streams.

## story builtins-004
summary:      Implement format and JSON conversion builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Format-Builtins.md
covers:       BUILTINS-004
provides:     tostring, tonumber, toboolean, tojson, fromjson, @text, @json, @html, @uri, @urid, @csv, @tsv, @sh, @base64, @base64d
consumes:     generator evaluator, string builtins
depends:      builtins-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement JSON conversion, scalar conversion, interpolation-aware formats, escaping,
  URI encoding, CSV/TSV/shell serialization, and base64 conversion using only the standard
  library.

## story builtins-005
summary:      Implement date, time, and math builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Date-and-Math-Builtins.md
covers:       BUILTINS-005
provides:     date conversion, broken-down time functions, numeric predicates, math functions
consumes:     generator evaluator
depends:      builtins-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement UTC date parsing and formatting, gmtime/mktime/strptime interfaces, now where
  exercised, standard math functions, numeric predicates, infinities, NaN, and floating-point
  edge behavior.

## story builtins-006
summary:      Implement environment, diagnostics, and input builtins.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Environment-and-IO.md
covers:       BUILTINS-006
provides:     input, inputs, debug, stderr, env, $ENV, $__loc__, builtins
consumes:     CLI stdin/stdout/stderr boundary, generator evaluator
depends:      foundation-002, builtins-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement remaining-input access, diagnostics, raw stderr output, environment snapshots,
  source location metadata, and builtin introspection without violating the CLI contract.

## story builtins-007
summary:      Implement streaming conversion builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Streaming-Builtins.md
covers:       BUILTINS-007
provides:     tostream, fromstream, truncate_stream
consumes:     generator evaluator, path engine
depends:      paths-001, builtins-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement jq stream representation, reconstruction, truncation, nested paths, and empty
  container markers according to the manual and corpus.

## story builtins-008
summary:      Implement remaining structural helper builtins.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        6
implements:   FEATURE-Remaining-Helpers.md
covers:       BUILTINS-008
provides:     walk, pick, INDEX, JOIN, IN, bsearch
consumes:     generator evaluator, path engine, structural builtins
depends:      builtins-001, paths-001, control-003
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Implement recursive walk, projection pick, SQL-style indexing and joins, stream membership,
  and binary search helpers with their documented generator behavior.

## story verification-001
summary:      Verify each implemented capability through executing scoped corpus slices.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        7
implements:   FEATURE-Scoped-Conformance.md
covers:       VERIFICATION-001
provides:     scoped conformance verification
consumes:     sources/run_conformance.py, ./jq
depends:      builtins-003, builtins-004, builtins-005, builtins-006, builtins-007, builtins-008
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/run_conformance.py, sources/jq.test, sources/exclusions.txt
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  Preserve the declared scoped gates for the implemented feature slices. Each slice must use
  the supplied harness with JQ supplied through the inherited environment, execute a non-empty
  selector, parse its JSON report, and require zero failures and errors.

## story verification-002
summary:      Prove the completed interpreter against the full supplied corpus.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        8
implements:   FEATURE-Full-Conformance.md
covers:       VERIFICATION-002
accepts:       st-001
provides:     full conformance release verification
consumes:     sources/full_test.sh, sources/run_conformance.py, ./jq
depends:      verification-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
context:      sources/full_test.sh, sources/run_conformance.py, sources/jq.test, sources/exclusions.txt
acceptance:   yes
scope:        target
instructions: |
  This is the terminal verification story. Run sh sources/full_test.sh from the completed
  application root, print captured stdout and stderr for diagnosis, and require only the
  command's successful exit status. It is the sole whole-corpus execution.

=== END ARTIFACT ===
